VAR LatestDateInFact =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( FactDailyReport[DateId] ),
        ALL ( FactDailyReport )
    )
VAR YesterdayDate = TODAY() - 1  -- Calculate yesterday's date
VAR DimDateAsDate = DATE(
    DIVIDE(RELATED(DimDate[Date]), 10000, 0),    -- Extract Year
    DIVIDE(MOD(RELATED(DimDate[Date]), 10000), 100, 0),  -- Extract Month
    MOD(RELATED(DimDate[Date]), 100)             -- Extract Day
)
RETURN
IF (
    COUNTROWS ( RELATEDTABLE ( FactDailyReport ) ) > 0,
    IF (
        DimDateAsDate = DATE(
            DIVIDE(LatestDateInFact, 10000, 0),    -- Extract Year from FactDailyReport
            DIVIDE(MOD(LatestDateInFact, 10000), 100, 0),  -- Extract Month
            MOD(LatestDateInFact, 100)             -- Extract Day
        ),
        "Latest",
        IF (
            DimDateAsDate = YesterdayDate,
            "Yesterday",  -- Mark yesterday's date
            FORMAT ( DimDateAsDate, "dd-MMM-yyyy" )
        )
    ),
    BLANK()
)
